title: Financial Document Analyzer
description: A full-stack system that processes financial documents (quarterly reports, balance sheets) asynchronously and surfaces LLM-driven insights through a modern, responsive UI. A FastAPI backend handles computation while a React frontend visualises the results.

title: Portfolio Website
description: This site's predecessor - a responsive, clean portfolio built with React + Vite using JSON-based dynamic rendering instead of hard-coded markup. Deployed on Netlify with optimised build settings.
